title: Juicy Malaysian Cheese-Pull Bao
description: A funky, cheese-pull, show-off Malaysian dish featuring salsa, broil, and Ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients. This breakfast dish is perfect for a weekend treat.

ingredients.name: Sattvic Salsa
ingredients.notes: mix of diced mango, red onion, cilantro, lime juice, and salt

ingredients.name: Ayurvedic Cheese
ingredients.notes: made from sheep's milk, rich and creamy

instructions: Place the Malaysian Bao Buns on a baking sheet and brush with olive oil.
Broil the buns for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Meanwhile, mix the Sattvic Salsa ingredients in a bowl.
Spread a layer of Cashew Cream on each bun.
Top with a slice of Ayurvedic Cheese and a spoonful of Sattvic Salsa.
Garnish with chopped Fresh Cilantro and a squeeze of Lime Juice.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make more buns.
